
# Compute frequency
## Load melted data
```{r}
##Issue with sample MS_204 (I guess there was an extra ";" in the text of one of the columns)
data16S <- tidyr::as_tibble(read.table(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "16S_melt_without_MS_204.csv"), header=TRUE, sep=";"))|>
dplyr::mutate(Marker="16S")
head(data16S)

##Issue with sample MS_204 (I guess there was an extra ";" in the text of one of the columns)
dataITS <- tidyr::as_tibble(read.table(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "ITS_melt_without_MS_204.csv"), header=TRUE, sep=";"))|>
dplyr::mutate(Marker="ITS")

data <- dplyr::bind_rows(data16S, dataITS)

## OTU present or absent
data <- data |>
dplyr::mutate(present=dplyr::if_else(Abundance>0, 1, 0))

## Compute frequency per type of sample
freq_data <- data  |>
  dplyr::group_by(Marker, SampleType, OTU, Family, Genus, Species) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Frequency = mean(present), Sample_size=dplyr::n())|>
  dplyr::ungroup()|>
  dplyr::mutate(Marker_OTU=paste(Marker, OTU, sep="_"))


## Compute frequency per type of sample and fruit
freq_data_perfruit <- data |>
  dplyr::group_by(Marker, FruitType, SampleType, OTU, Family, Genus, Species) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Frequency = mean(present), Sample_size=dplyr::n())|>
  dplyr::ungroup()|>
  dplyr::mutate(Marker_OTU=paste(Marker, OTU, sep="_"))


```
  
# Fruit samples only
## Taxa across all three fruits
### Select frequency across all three fruits 
```{r}

## Select only fruits
freq_data_fruit <- freq_data |>
dplyr::filter(SampleType%in%c("Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days"))

freq_data_70 <- freq_data_fruit |>
  dplyr::filter(Frequency>0.7) |>
  tidyr::separate(col = "OTU", into=c(NA, "OTU_ID"), sep="_",
  remove = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(OTU_ID=as.numeric(OTU_ID)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Marker, OTU_ID) 

write.table(x=freq_data_70, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "freq_OTU_fruit_only.csv"), sep=";", row.names=FALSE)

```

### Prevalence
```{r}
prevalence_data <- freq_data_fruit |>
  dplyr::filter(Marker_OTU%in%freq_data_70$Marker_OTU)|>
  dplyr::mutate(OTUname=paste(Genus, OTU, sep="_"))|>
  dplyr::mutate(SampleType_Sample_size=paste0(SampleType, " (n=", Sample_size, ")")) |>
  dplyr::select(Marker, OTUname, OTU, SampleType, SampleType_Sample_size, Frequency)

prevalence_data_wide <- prevalence_data |>
  dplyr::select(-SampleType_Sample_size) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = SampleType, values_from = Frequency)

write.table(x=prevalence_data_wide, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "prevalence_data_fruit_only.csv"), sep=";", row.names=FALSE)
```

### Make plot
```{r}
p16S <- prevalence_data |>
  dplyr::filter(Marker=="16S")|>
  ggplot(aes(SampleType_Sample_size, OTUname, fill= Frequency)) + 
  geom_tile()+
scale_fill_gradient(low="white", high="blue") +
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))

pITS <- prevalence_data |>
  dplyr::filter(Marker=="ITS")|>
  ggplot(aes(SampleType_Sample_size, OTUname, fill= Frequency)) + 
  geom_tile()+
scale_fill_gradient(low="white", high="blue") +
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))

panel <- p16S + pITS+
  patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
panel
ggsave(filename = "prevalence_allfruits_fruit_only.jpg", path = file.path(here::here(), "plots", "3_CommunityComposition"), width = 30, height = 20, units = "cm")
```

### Relevel Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size
#### 16S
```{r}
## Order we want
lev <- c("G0_Adults_0days","G0_Adults_Fruits_2days","Fruits_0days","Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days","Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days","Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days","G1_Larvae_Fruits","G1_Larvae_Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days","G1_Pupae_Fruits","G1_Pupae_Nat_Inf_Fruit_5_6days","G1_PupalCase_Fruits","G1_Adults_Fruits","G1_Adults_Nat_Inf_Fruit_5_6days")

prevalence_data_fruit16S <- prevalence_data_fruit |>
  dplyr::filter(Marker=="16S")|>
  dplyr::mutate(Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size=factor(Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size))

fact <- levels(prevalence_data_fruit16S$Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size)
## Extract levels in the right order
new_level_order <- fact[grep("na", fact, value = FALSE)]
for (fruit_i in c("BL", "CH", "ST")){
  out <- setNames(sapply(paste(fruit_i,lev, sep="_"), function(x) grep(x, fact, value = FALSE)), lev)
new_level_order <- c(new_level_order, fact[unlist(out)])
}

prevalence_data_fruit16S <- prevalence_data_fruit16S |>
  dplyr::mutate(Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size=factor(Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size, new_level_order))



```

#### ITS
```{r}
## Order we want
lev <- c("G0_Adults_0days","G0_Adults_Fruits_2days","Fruits_0days","Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days","Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days","Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days","G1_Larvae_Fruits","G1_Larvae_Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days","G1_Pupae_Fruits","G1_Pupae_Nat_Inf_Fruit_5_6days","G1_PupalCase_Fruits","G1_Adults_Fruits","G1_Adults_Nat_Inf_Fruit_5_6days")

prevalence_data_fruitITS <- prevalence_data_fruit |>
  dplyr::filter(Marker=="ITS")|>
  dplyr::mutate(Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size=factor(Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size))

fact <- levels(prevalence_data_fruitITS$Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size)
## Extract levels in the right order
new_level_order <- fact[grep("na", fact, value = FALSE)]
for (fruit_i in c("BL", "CH", "ST")){
  out <- setNames(sapply(paste(fruit_i,lev, sep="_"), function(x) grep(x, fact, value = FALSE)), lev)
new_level_order <- c(new_level_order, fact[unlist(out)])
}

prevalence_data_fruitITS <- prevalence_data_fruitITS |>
  dplyr::mutate(Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size=factor(Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size, new_level_order))


```
